cardOverview.overviewText: A Pioneer Legacy card offering lifestyle rewards, milestone benefits, and premium privileges, crafted for customers with long-standing IndusInd relationships.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 free offer on movie tickets on BookMyShow, available thrice monthly with a complimentary ticket capped at ₹200.|Additionally, enjoy an exclusive 20% discount, up to ₹200, on non-movie bookings.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail any of these services, please call the concierge desk at 1860 267 7777.
